EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM com_interaction mine WHERE mine.user_id = #{viewer_id} AND mine.action_type = 'like' AND mine.target_id = c.id) AS liked 0 AS liked FROM com_content c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT target_id, SUM(CASE WHEN action_type = 'like' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS like_count, SUM(CASE WHEN action_type = 'favorite' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS favorite_count, SUM(CASE WHEN action_type = 'like' AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS week_likes, SUM(CASE WHEN action_type = 'favorite' AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS week_favorites, SUM(CASE WHEN action_type = 'derivation' AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS week_uses, SUM(CASE WHEN action_type = 'like' AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS month_likes, SUM(CASE WHEN action_type = 'favorite' AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS month_favorites, SUM(CASE WHEN action_type = 'derivation' AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS month_uses FROM com_interaction WHERE action_type IN ('like', 'favorite', 'derivation') GROUP BY target_id ) s ON s.target_id = c.id WHERE c.status = 'public' AND c.content_type = #{content_type} AND c.subject = #{subject} AND c.grade = #{grade}
